items.title: 32.2 Importance of pH in Stomach (maide mein pH ki ahmiyat) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 32.2, printed page 231 (PDF 234). The stomach diagram is our aid, not a printed figure.

blocks.text: Stomach (maida) bohat acidic (tezabi) jagah hai; is ka pH kam, yani 1.5 se 3.5 tak hota hai. Yeh acidity (tezabiyat) parietal cells control karte hain, jo zor laga kar hydrogen ions (H⁺) maide mein pump karte hain. Yeh process khana hazam karne aur bacteria ko maarne ke liye zaroori hai. pH itna kam hone ke bawajood maida apni hifazat khud karta hai: is ki deewar par mucus (chipchipa liquid) ki moti layer (teh) aur bicarbonate ions hote hain, jo cell ki surface (satah) par acid ko neutralize (be-asar) kar dete hain.

Maide ka kam pH non-specific reactions (aise reactions jo kisi khaas cheez ke liye nahi, kisi par bhi ho jaate hain) kar sakta hai, yani yeh kuch dawaiyon ko chemically badal sakta hai. Maslan kuch dawaiyan khoon mein absorb (jazb) hone se pehle hi acidic mahol mein toot jaati hain. Isi liye kuch dawaiyan aik protective coating (hifazati teh) ke saath di jaati hain jo sirf kam acidic small intestine (chhoti aant) mein jaa kar ghulti hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: stomach ka andar (pH 1.5-3.5, H+ ions), us ke neeche mucus + HCO3- ki tah ('neutralise acid'), aur sab se neeche deewar ke cells jin se do surkh teer H+ ko andar pump karte hain ('parietal cells pump H+'). Daen: coated goli stomach mein saboot ('coating intact'), phir small intestine mein coating ghul jati hai ('coating dissolves').
blocks.caption: Stomach ki acidity aur coated goliyan (hamari drawing; kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Baen hissa: parietal cells H⁺ ions ko stomach ke andar pump karte hain, is liye pH 1.5–3.5 rehta hai. Deewar par mucus aur HCO₃⁻ ki layer acid ko deewar tak pohanchne se pehle neutralize kar deti hai. Daen hissa: coated goli stomach ke acid mein saboot rehti hai; small intestine mein, jahan acid kam hai, coating ghulti hai aur dawa wahan absorb hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Maida apni deewar ko apne hi acid se kaise bachata hai?
blocks.explanation: Mucus ki moti teh aur bicarbonate ions se, jo cell ki surface par acid ko neutralize kar dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Kuch goliyon par khaas coating kyun hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: Taake dawa maide ke tez acid mein toot na jaye; coating sirf kam acidic chhoti aant mein ghulti hai jahan dawa absorb hoti hai.

items: Maide ka pH 1.5–3.5; parietal cells H⁺ ions pump karte hain.
Mucus aur bicarbonate ions maide ki deewar bachate hain.
Acid kuch dawaiyan tor deta hai; is liye coated goliyan chhoti aant mein ghulti hain.
